project_type: Full-stack SaaS starter kit - Go backend + React SPA frontend
build_system: Go modules (backend), Vite + npm (frontend), Makefile for orchestration
build_command: cd /projects/sandbox/echo-saas-starter && go build ./... && cd ui && npm run build
test_command: cd /projects/sandbox/echo-saas-starter && go test ./... && cd ui && npm run test
verification_instructions: Backend: go build ./..., go vet ./..., go test ./... (all exit 0). Frontend: cd ui && npx tsc --noEmit && npm run build (all exit 0, zero errors/warnings).
setup_instructions: 1. go mod init echo-saas-starter, 2. Initialize ui/ with Vite+React+TypeScript, 3. Install all Go and npm dependencies
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access. Go 1.25.1, Node.js v22, npm/pnpm available. golangci-lint 2.1.6 available.
contribution_requirements: Plugin architecture: each plugin self-contained under internal/plugins/<name>/ and ui/src/plugins/<name>/. Registration only in internal/plugins/registry.go. Removing a plugin requires only deleting its directory and removing from registry.
key_patterns: Plugin interface pattern: Name(), Version(), Init(), RegisterRoutes(), Migrate(), Shutdown(). Database abstraction with auto-detect from URL scheme. PASETO v4 local tokens. go:embed for SPA serving.
directory_structure: cmd/server/ - entry point | internal/core/ - plugin system, DB interface, middleware | internal/config/ - configuration | internal/database/ - DB drivers | internal/embed/ - go:embed SPA | internal/server/ - Echo setup | internal/plugins/<name>/ - feature plugins | ui/ - React SPA with Vite | ui/src/routes/ - file-based routing | ui/src/plugins/ - frontend plugin modules | ui/src/components/ - shared UI components | ui/src/lib/ - utilities and API client
